verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of an admin-facing search over full message history with sender, channel, or date filters. The Export APIs only let developers bulk-export chat and channel messages, which is a building block rather than filtered search, and community reports describe search as weak but do not document filters. With no direct evidence, the verdict stays none.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date
